responsibility: Provides the shared D frontend hook implementation for glibc-based targets. It adds the Posix D builtin version and then delegates to GNU_USER_TARGET_D_OS_VERSIONS and EXTRA_TARGET_D_OS_VERSIONS macros so architecture or OS overlays can contribute further builtin version identifiers; it also registers an ELF object-format target-info handler for __traits(getTargetInfo). This file is the common D/glibc substrate rather than a single OS-specific specialization.
